intro: Between April and September 2026, ZCyberNews covered seven data-leak incidents, with 0APT and Rhysida appearing as the most frequently cited threat actors. Coverage spanned government, business services, e-commerce, education, and financial-services sectors, affecting regions including the European Union, Germany, Latvia, and NATO, alongside global reports. The severity mix included one critical, four high, and one medium incident. These reports tracked exposed records and leak disclosures across these distinct actors, with no single event dominating the archive’s timeline from mid-April through early September.
